en:
If Shuichi was in charge of setting the sensor,
then we don't know if he actually did it.

He used Kaede as a patsy to make her think
Rantaro was alive when the sensor went off.

I need to think it over again!

There's no point arguing against me...

Until you can disprove Shuichi had the 
sensor, he will remain suspicious.
